svg.text: Six planes, one page. The model writes the sections.
The scroll engine is fixed before a model is ever called.

g.text: prompt + style preset + model + optional image
runToken makes stale runs unable to overwrite newer results.
CopyDoc: real copy for every section, reconciled
Clamp, reconcile and R1-R7 auto-correct; they do not reject.
N small calls, not one fragile page.
one server call per section: HTML, CSS, JS
contract card for that section's intent only
real copy verbatim; neighbour kind hints
Latency is close to one call; a failure stays local.
HTML root + banned tags; parse-only JS
CSS scoped to .s-{id}; no CSS-hidden states
one repair with the exact error, then fallback
origin is generated, repaired or fallback. No section sinks the page.
deterministic shell: fonts, reset, theme tokens
registry + gsap.context; reduced motion skips init
27 animated intents + none. The model never writes the engine.
full srcdoc swap on every new bundle
No accounts, no history. Every generation is ephemeral.
Lenis, gsap.ticker, ScrollTrigger.refresh and plugin registration are harness-owned.
Generated JS that touches them is rejected by lint, not accommodated.
Regenerate one section: one codegen call, one validation pass,
then re-assemble the whole page. The other modules stay put.

svg.text: SOURCES: VIBELY CODE + VERIFIED LIVE RUN · COFFEE PAGE IS GENERATED DEMO COPY · NO INVENTED SYSTEM METRICS
